description: Dancers face the way the ring travels and walk it one behind another.

walkthrough.line: Face the way the ring is going and walk {direction} round it in single file.
walkthrough.teach: Turn to face the way the ring is going — {direction} — and walk round it in single file, each of you behind the one in front, with your hands at your sides. A quarter of the ring is one place along and a half is two. You stop still facing the way you were travelling.
